sources: PJ Ace burned-caption pattern (15-25 char hook reads in 0-3s)
_meta.principle: Text overlays are NOT generated inside the I2V model — they're rendered in Remotion or burned via ffmpeg drawtext at assembly. Veo/Runway can't reliably produce legible UI text. Plan typography at storyboard time; execute at assembly time.

all_caps_punchline.name: All-Caps Punchline
all_caps_punchline.use: Toxic Sundae, anti-fast-fashion energy — short setup + accent word
all_caps_punchline.spec: ALL CAPS condensed, 18-24px (Reels), accent word in brand color, max 8 words
all_caps_punchline.fragment: ALL CAPS condensed, 18-24px (Reels), accent word in brand color, max 8 words

founder_first_person.name: Founder First-Person
founder_first_person.use: HR / DV — direct quote from founder, no quotation marks
founder_first_person.spec: Sentence case, body weight, 14-18px Reels, max 12 words across 2 lines
founder_first_person.fragment: Sentence case, body weight, 14-18px Reels, max 12 words across 2 lines

minimal_name_role.name: Minimal Name + Role
minimal_name_role.spec: Name in display font 18-22px, role in mono/sans 12px below, brand-accent underline
minimal_name_role.fragment: Name in display font 18-22px, role in mono/sans 12px below, brand-accent underline

domain_only_outro.name: Domain-Only Outro
domain_only_outro.use: Final 1-2s frame — single line, brand domain, accent color underline
domain_only_outro.spec: Domain in mono or display font 24-32px, brand-accent color, no caps unless brand demands it
domain_only_outro.fragment: Domain in mono or display font 24-32px, brand-accent color, no caps unless brand demands it

tagline_plus_url.name: Tagline + URL stack
tagline_plus_url.spec: Tagline display font 22px, URL mono 14px below, both in brand-accent
tagline_plus_url.fragment: Tagline display font 22px, URL mono 14px below, both in brand-accent

vo_subtitle_burned.name: VO Subtitle Burned
vo_subtitle_burned.use: Mobile-feed default — most viewers watch sound-off, captions are mandatory
vo_subtitle_burned.spec: 1-2 lines max on screen, sentence case, 16-18px (Reels), high-contrast white-on-dark or dark-on-light, 1px outline for legibility on busy backgrounds
vo_subtitle_burned.tools: Remotion <Captions> component or ffmpeg drawtext per word-timestamp
vo_subtitle_burned.fragment: 1-2 lines max on screen, sentence case, 16-18px (Reels), high-contrast white-on-dark or dark-on-light, 1px outline for legibility on busy backgrounds

word_by_word_punctuation.name: Word-by-Word Punctuation
word_by_word_punctuation.use: Copy-led posts, no photo, kinetic-only Reels
word_by_word_punctuation.spec: Each word fades in on its own beat, 0.2s per word, key word lands on the punchline beat with 1.4× scale
word_by_word_punctuation.fragment: Each word fades in on its own beat, 0.2s per word, key word lands on the punchline beat with 1.4× scale

screen_content_composite._label: Screen content composite — UI/text on a laptop or phone screen rendered as a Remotion overlay because I2V models cannot render UI text reliably
screen_content_composite._lesson: feedback_i2v_cant_render_ui_text.md (2026-05-04). Veo / Kling / Seedance hallucinate chat bubbles, input field fills, app switches, sent ticks. Plan the screen content as a composite from storyboard time. Set image_recipe.depth='foreground_object_blur' on the I2V shot so the screen reads as soft ambient glow, then mask + overlay the real UI in Remotion at assembly stage 5b.

chat_message_typing.name: Chat Message Typing
chat_message_typing.use: Dictation beats — text appears word-by-word in a chat input field as the protagonist speaks, then sends
chat_message_typing.spec: Mockup chat window (generic, not branded) at the on-screen position of the laptop in the I2V frame. Tracked via 4-corner laptop screen mask from the underlying clip. Text fills the input field word-by-word at the VO word-timestamps; on the 'sent' beat the bubble pops into the conversation thread with a tick.
chat_message_typing.position: track the laptop screen mask in the underlying clip
chat_message_typing.tools: Remotion <ScreenComposite> with @remotion/captions for word timing + corner-pin tracking. Underlying clip MUST be rendered with image_recipe.depth='foreground_object_blur' so the I2V screen is soft and the overlay sits cleanly on top.
chat_message_typing.fragment: Mockup chat window (generic, not branded) at the on-screen position of the laptop in the I2V frame. Tracked via 4-corner laptop screen mask from the underlying clip. Text fills the input field word-by-word at the VO word-timestamps; on the 'sent' beat the bubble pops into the conversation thread with a tick.

window_switch_animation.name: Window Switch Animation
window_switch_animation.use: App-switch beats — one window slides forward while another recedes (e.g. chat → email)
window_switch_animation.spec: Two stacked window mockups at the laptop screen position; on the wake-word beat the foreground window slides one way and the new window slides forward with a soft ease-in. A copper menu-bar dot pulses briefly at the same beat.
window_switch_animation.duration_s: 0.4-0.6s for the slide, plus settled state
window_switch_animation.tools: Remotion <WindowSwitch> with copper accent layer. I2V shot rendered with foreground_object_blur.
window_switch_animation.fragment: Two stacked window mockups at the laptop screen position; on the wake-word beat the foreground window slides one way and the new window slides forward with a soft ease-in. A copper menu-bar dot pulses briefly at the same beat.

wake_word_pulse.name: Wake-Word Menu-Bar Pulse
wake_word_pulse.use: Wake-word activation beats — a small accent dot in the top menu bar of the laptop pulses briefly to confirm 'decipher' fired
wake_word_pulse.spec: Single dot at top-right of the laptop screen mask, brand-accent color, scale 1.0 → 1.4 → 1.0 over 0.3s with ease-out, then a steady solid dot held for the rest of the shot
wake_word_pulse.tools: Remotion <PulseDot> at the screen corner. Lightweight composite — works even if the rest of the screen is rendered untouched in the I2V.
wake_word_pulse.fragment: Single dot at top-right of the laptop screen mask, brand-accent color, scale 1.0 → 1.4 → 1.0 over 0.3s with ease-out, then a steady solid dot held for the rest of the shot

sent_tick.name: Sent Tick
sent_tick.use: Message-sent beats — small checkmark or tick appears next to the last chat bubble
sent_tick.spec: Single tick glyph at the right edge of the most-recent message bubble, fades in over 0.15s, brand-accent color
sent_tick.position: right of last bubble in the chat composite
sent_tick.tools: Remotion <SentTick>. Must be tied to the audio sent_tick SFX timing in audio.json.
sent_tick.fragment: Single tick glyph at the right edge of the most-recent message bubble, fades in over 0.15s, brand-accent color

notification_toast.name: Notification Toast
notification_toast.use: Phone ping / message arrival beats — a toast notification slides down at the top of a phone or laptop screen
notification_toast.spec: Toast at top of screen mask, slides down 0.25s + holds 1.5s + slides up 0.2s. Generic icon (no platform branding), single line of text
notification_toast.tools: Remotion <Toast>. Pair with messenger_ping SFX from audio.json.
notification_toast.fragment: Toast at top of screen mask, slides down 0.25s + holds 1.5s + slides up 0.2s. Generic icon (no platform branding), single line of text

screen_glow_only.name: Screen Glow Only (no UI overlay)
screen_glow_only.use: When the screen content doesn't need to be specific — let it read as ambient cyan/copper glow on the protagonist's face. Cheapest option, no compositing required.
screen_glow_only.spec: I2V renders screen with image_recipe.depth='foreground_object_blur'. Screen reads as a soft cool glow casting on the subject's face. No Remotion overlay needed.
screen_glow_only.fragment: I2V renders screen with image_recipe.depth='foreground_object_blur'. Screen reads as a soft cool glow casting on the subject's face. No Remotion overlay needed.

instagram_reels_9x16.note: Keep all critical text inside the central 1080×1320 zone of a 1080×1920 canvas.

tiktok_9x16.note: TikTok bottom UI is taller than IG — reserve more bottom space.

instagram_feed_1x1.note: Square is the friendliest canvas — minimal platform chrome.

rules.no_text_in_i2v_prompt: Never ask Veo/Runway/Kling to render UI text — illegible 95% of the time. Add text in post.
rules.min_contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 WCAG AA against the moving footage behind
rules.outline_required: Captions need a 1-2px outline OR a semi-opaque background bar for legibility on variable-brightness video
rules.font_per_brand: Use the brand's typography stack (CLAUDE.md). Never substitute.
